_meta.rule: Single source of numbers for every VestVentures document. Do not type numbers by hand elsewhere.
_meta.currency: EUR; RON converted at 5.0 RON = 1 EUR
_meta.status: Everything after 6 Oct 2026 is a PROJECTION. Zero paying customers today.

round_split.option_a_note: Vest Ventures ticket + the minimum 10% private co-investment only

stage: Pre-seed (apply to the Vest Ventures Accelerator, not Seed: zero revenue)
instrument: Convertible loan agreement (CLA) or SHA on Vest Ventures' templates; modelled as priced equity at the pre-money valuation (a CLA would use it as the valuation cap, illustrative 20% discount)
esop_note: 10% of post-money, created pre-money (dilutes founders only); virtual/phantom scheme while the company is an SRL [TO CONFIRM]

illustrative_seed.note: ILLUSTRATIVE only, no seed discussion has taken place

runway_basis: Months the round pays every planned cost with ZERO revenue (base cost plan)

round_size_test.case: VV ticket alone (not allowed without private match)
VV maximum ticket + minimum 10% private match

use_of_funds.category: Accountant channel & sales (partner manager, travel, commissions)

use_of_funds_basis: Share of planned spend over the zero-revenue runway (months 1-16), applied to the round
close_month: Jan 2027 (model month 1) - ASSUMPTION; Vest Ventures Accelerator Cohort 3 dates are not published
base_note: Base case is NOT default-alive: without a seed round cash runs out after runway_plan_months; the seed raise starts at the 100-paying-customer milestone. cash_low_point_eur < 0 = shortfall without a seed.

unit_economics.gross_margin_definition: Contribution margin per customer: (ARPA - variable infra - payment fees) / ARPA
unit_economics.gross_margin_pnl_definition: P&L gross margin after fixed hosting and the onboarding/support salary (year 2)
unit_economics.cac_definition: Fully loaded: partner manager salary + marketing + travel + accountant commissions / new paying customers
unit_economics.benchmarks: ChartMogul median churn 6.1%/month for ARPA < US$25; SMB CAC payback median ~11 months, 6-14 healthy (piata.md §d.1)

team_plan.note: new accountant partners per month scale with this FTE
hired after the seed; not funded by the pre-seed round

pricing.plan: HR core (attendance, leave, personnel file, employee portal)
Extended HR package (core + REGES, onboarding, courses, SSM, evaluations, KPI)
Operations package (core + fleet, maintenance, inventory, announcements, ticketing)
Finance package (core + payroll, per diem, reports)

pricing.note: Flat price per company up to 20 employees; first month free; no setup fee; seller not VAT-registered so prices are final. No published price above 20 employees. Add-on modules 15-69 RON/month each (payroll 69). Accountant pilot: free until 31 Mar 2027, then 20% commission for 6 months to the accountant.

milestones.milestone: Pre-seed round closes (assumed); both co-founders full time
Partner & sales manager hired (accountant channel), part-time (50%)
Accountant pilot ends (free until 31 Mar 2027); pilot companies convert to paid (founders onboard them)
Payroll legal values validated by an accountant (payroll moves from 'built, undergoing validation' to sellable)
Customer onboarding & support specialist hired, part-time (50%)
100 paying customers - seed-readiness trigger (start seed / VV Seed conversations)
Onboarding & support specialist full time (after the seed)
